job_description:
Mastek is hiring an Oracle PL/SQL Developer in Riyadh, KSA. The role focuses on developing robust PL/SQL packages, tuning SQL, and supporting end-to-end Oracle deployments. Applicants should have at least 2 years of experience and Saudi National citizenship.

You will work with cross-functional teams in Agile environments, delivering high-integrity data solutions and ensuring performance and security standards are met. Immediate joining preferred, permanent full-time engagement.
